name: Arizona
notes: Arizona was one of the first states to launch a digital ID. It is supported in Apple Wallet and Google Wallet, and Arizona also has its own state app (AZ MVD Now).

wallets.name: Apple Wallet
steps: Open the Wallet app on your iPhone (iOS 15.4 or later required).
Tap the + button and choose 'Driver's License or State ID'.
Select Arizona from the state list.
Scan the front and back of your Arizona driver license or ID card.
Complete the face and motion scan to verify your identity.
Your request is sent to the Arizona MVD. You'll get a notification once it's approved — usually within minutes.

wallets.name: Google Wallet
steps: Open Google Wallet on your Android phone.
Tap + and select 'ID documents', then 'Driver's license or state ID'.
Choose Arizona.
Scan the front and back of your physical Arizona ID.
Complete the selfie step to verify your identity.
Arizona MVD will process and approve your digital ID within a few minutes.

wallets.name: Samsung Wallet
steps: Open Samsung Wallet on your Samsung device.
Tap + and select 'ID'.
Choose Arizona.
Scan the front and back of your Arizona driver's license or ID.
Complete the identity verification step.
Arizona MVD will verify and approve your digital ID.

wallets.name: AZ MVD Now
steps: Download the AZ MVD Now app from the App Store or Google Play.
Sign in or create a ServiceArizona account.
Tap 'Add Mobile ID' from the home screen.
Scan the front and back of your Arizona driver license or ID.
Complete the identity verification selfie.
Your Mobile ID will appear in the app once approved.
